description: This file defines functions for executing user actions in a Playwright recorder context, including navigation, clicking, filling forms, and assertions, utilizing imported utilities and types.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes a specified user action within a page context, handling navigation, clicks, form interactions, and assertions.

methods.name: performActionImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation of performAction, dispatching actions based on their name.

methods.name: toClickOptions
methods.description: Converts a click action into Playwright mouse click options, including button, modifiers, click count, and position.
